title: Number of Offenders Nabbed Following Smoking Ban in Orchard Road Area
what_it_is: Number of Offenders Nabbed Following Smoking Ban in Orchard Road Area

sections.label: Orchard Road No-Smoking Zone
sections.summary: The Orchard Road No-Smoking Zone began on 1 January 2019, with advisories issued and offences falling, and over 50 designated smoking areas provided.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: The Orchard Road No-Smoking Zone (NSZ) came into force on 1 January 2019, as part of the Government's efforts to protect non-smokers from the harmful effects of second-hand tobacco smoke.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: A daily average of 735 advisories were issued to offenders between January and March 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: The number of recorded offences decreased from 21 cases per day on 1 April 2019 to around 15 cases per day at present.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: As such, NEA works closely with the Orchard Road Business Association or ORBA, and building owners to ensure sufficient provision of designated smoking areas or DSAs).

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: There are now more than 50 DSAs in the NSZ, spaced about 100 to 200 m apart.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: The number of DSAs in the NSZ is currently sufficient.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: As far as possible, the DSAs are sited in less conspicuous locations and away from the main pedestrian thoroughfare, to ensure that smoking is contained and not done in clear view of passers-by.

sections.label: Enforcement outside Orchard Road zone
sections.summary: Smoking outside the Orchard Road No Smoking Zone is not prohibited, but officers monitor nearby areas and litter bins were relocated away from residential premises.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Smoking outside the boundary of the Orchard Road No Smoking Zone is not prohibited but what we have done is to send our enforcement officers to these areas, around Nutmeg Road, Jalan Lada Puteh, Jalan Jintan and so on, to monitor the ground situation as well as to take enforcement action against anyone found to have committed any public health offences – for instance, littering of cigarette butts and indeed, we have actually done this.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We have also sought to relocate any litter bins around the area further away from the residential premises so that they do not congregate near the residential homes.
